components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Crimson primary action with a crimson-tinted lift; one per context.
components.html: Call Kunal
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.55rem; min-height: 48px; padding: 0.75rem 1.4rem; border: 1.5px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, sans-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.2; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid var(--crimson, #a3162d); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--crimson, #a3162d); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(132,16,31,0.3), 0 8px 20px -10px rgba(163,22,45,0.7); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--crimson-dark, #84101f); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(132,16,31,0.3), 0 14px 28px -12px rgba(163,22,45,0.8); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action beside the primary (e.g. WhatsApp us).
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.55rem; min-height: 48px; padding: 0.75rem 1.4rem; background: var(--white, #fff); color: var(--ink, #16181d); border: 1.5px solid var(--line-strong, #cfcdc6); border-radius: 8px; font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, sans-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.2; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: var(--ink, #16181d); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid var(--crimson, #a3162d); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Enquiry form field with label; crimson border and halo on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.45rem; font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, sans-serif); } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink, #16181d); } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 52px; padding: 0.8rem 1rem; font: inherit; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--ink, #16181d); background: #fff; border: 1.5px solid var(--line-strong, #cfcdc6); border-radius: 8px; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #7a7e86; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #a9a7a0; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--crimson, #a3162d); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(163,22,45,0.14); }

components.name: Header Navigation
components.description: Sticky white header under a crimson letterhead rule; links wipe a crimson underline on hover.
components.html: ServicesHow we workWhy ICSContact
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 2rem; padding: 1.5rem 2rem; background: #fff; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--crimson, #a3162d); font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, sans-serif); } .ds-nav a { position: relative; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink-2, #3a3e46); text-decoration: none; padding: 0.4rem 0; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-nav a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -2px; height: 2px; background: var(--crimson, #a3162d); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: right; transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--ink, #16181d); } .ds-nav a:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); transform-origin: left; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid var(--crimson, #a3162d); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.description: Services explorer tab; active tab is crimson on a blush marker.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: grid; gap: 2px; width: 340px; font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, sans-serif); } .ds-tab { width: 100%; padding: 1rem 1.1rem; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; background: transparent; text-align: left; font: inherit; font-size: 1.0625rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink-2, #3a3e46); cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.25s; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--ink, #16181d); background: var(--surface, #f5f4f0); } .ds-tab.is-active { color: var(--crimson, #a3162d); font-weight: 650; background: var(--crimson-tint, #fbeef0); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2.5px solid var(--crimson, #a3162d); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-steps { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 2.5rem; padding: 4.5rem 2rem 2rem; background: var(--charcoal, #17191f); color: var(--on-dark, #f3f2ee); font-family: var(--font, 'Archivo Variable', Archivo, sans-serif); } .ds-rail { position: absolute; left: 2rem; right: 50%; top: calc(2rem + 21px); height: 2px; background: var(--crimson, #a3162d); } .ds-step { position: relative; } .ds-dot { position: absolute; top: -4.5rem; left: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25); background: var(--charcoal, #17191f); color: var(--on-dark-muted, #b4b6bd); font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; transition: background-color 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), border-color 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-step.is-reached .ds-dot { background: var(--crimson, #a3162d); border-color: var(--crimson, #a3162d); color: #fff; } .ds-step h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 650; letter-spacing: -0.015em; }

narrative.overview:
ICS is the category standard for a corporate services site, played without quirk at the craft level of Infosys BPM and Wipro. Authority comes from order: a white ground, charcoal ink, a single crimson drawn from the company letterhead, a grotesque used for every word, and structure doing the work that invented proof would do elsewhere. The page reads like a well-kept business document: a thin crimson rule under the header and over the footer, sections stacked in a predictable rhythm, numbers set in tabular figures.

Density is moderate and calm. Sections breathe on a fluid vertical rhythm, content sits in a 1240px container, and the composition alternates white, warm off-white surface, one deep charcoal band (process) and one crimson band (call to action). Depth is soft and ambient, reserved for the objects that matter (the hero register, the enquiry form, primary buttons). Motion is one authored grammar, an exponential ease-out, spent on a few meaningful moments rather than sprinkled on scroll.

The logo is a fixed brand asset recreated from the letterhead, not a typographic choice: traced vector paths for the heavy condensed ICS, a thin dark-red rule, and "Integrated / Care / Solutions" stacked in Archivo at 88% width.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, charcoal ink, one crimson used sparingly and meaningfully.
One family (Archivo Variable, with width axis) for all text, tight negative tracking on headings.
Thin crimson rules as the letterhead echo: header bottom, footer top, scroll progress, process rail.
Soft, ambient shadows; flat everywhere else, separated by 1px warm hairlines.
One authored line-icon set on a 24px grid, single stroke, rendered in ink or muted.
Exponential ease-out motion with reduced-motion fully respected.

rules.name: The Reserved Crimson Rule
rules.body: Crimson means brand, action, active, link or letterhead rule. It never decorates an icon, a bullet or a background texture. Decorative icons are ink or muted.

rules.name: The Green Means Verified Rule
rules.body: Success and verification use Ledger Green, never crimson. Crimson is not a status color for "done".

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Every word on the site is Archivo. Weight and tracking create hierarchy; no second display face. The logo is an asset, not a type style.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Label Rule
rules.body: Labels are sentence case at 600 weight. There are no uppercase tracked labels above headings.

rules.name: The Earned Shadow Rule
rules.body: Only the register, the form, primary buttons, icon tiles and the scrolled header cast shadows. Panels, cards and lists stay flat with hairlines.

dos: Do keep crimson to brand mark, primary action, active state, links and the letterhead rules (header bottom, footer top, scroll progress, process rail).
Do use Ledger Green for verified and success states.
Do draw icons from the one authored line set (24px grid, single stroke, round joins) and render decorative icons in ink or muted.
Do use the logo component and its traced paths exactly as built; the favicon reuses the same paths.
Do set numbers in tabular figures wherever they align or update.
Do use the shared exponential ease-out and honor reduced motion with a finished, static state.
donts: Don't add section-number counters or numbered section prefixes.
Don't add decorative grid, line or dot textures to grounds.
Don't add eyebrow or kicker labels above headings.
Don't introduce a second display typeface or redraw the logo in live type.
Don't use hard or offset shadows; depth stays soft and ambient.
Don't show invented proof as design elements (stat counters, client logo strips, testimonial cards).
